messages.subject: Problem updating ggplot2 package
parts:
Hi
  I am having problems with running an app on glimmer that works fine locally
It may come down to  a ggplot issue and lookng at my glimmer library I had 2 versions 
0.9.3.1 amd 0.9.2.1 available. I tried, and failed to remove the older version, so that I had same package
locallu and on glimmer. I could remove the newer package but when trying to update got the message that all
packages were updated
Any idea what is going on
cheers
agc

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Problem updating ggplot2 package

Oh, are you getting ggplot2 0.9.2.1 in your Shiny app, or in your RStudio session, or both?

If it's in your Shiny app, you may need to restart your app: just create a file called restart.txt in your app directory. It should restart the app, which will also reload all the libraries.

OK I think have sorted this issue. Other than the problem with the two ggplot packages I'm not sure it is anything to do with Shiny per se
but would value any comments

I am scraping a webpage and using the XML package to extract data
e.g.
myURL <- "http://www.baseball-reference.com/players/gl.cgi?id=wainwad01&t=p&year=2006"
 
     y <- readHTMLTable(myURL,  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    logs <- y[["pitching_gamelogs"]]

logs has a column Date which I want to manipulate to be useful

Locally, it has the form in the logs$Date AprÂ 3, AprÂ 7  etc., so I need to take account of the extraneous Â which I did via str_sub
In Glimmer it appears to  be of form logs$Date Apr 3, Apr 7 so my manipulation ended up in a lot of errors or NAs
Would presumably have saved some grief if I had str_replace "Â" with "" to start with but still a bit of a strange discrepancy
